parts.text: Edit only the ball he holds: it is a capture-ball style sphere with a cream goalie mask set into its front. Make a clear horizontal seam split all the way around the sphere AND straight across the middle of the mask, as if the whole ball (mask included) can snap open into top and bottom halves on a hinge, with a small round latch at the seam on the side. The top half of the sphere is glossy deep purple, the bottom half white; the mask keeps its cream colour on both halves, with the seam line cutting across it. Remove the red slash and triangle markings from the mask; use only dark scratches and rust stains. No letters, no M, no pink spots, no logos. Keep the man, cap, pin vest, golden axe, background and clay style exactly the same.
